taste:
The fish finger sandwich is built around the contrast between crisp breaded cod and soft sliced bread. Thick fish fingers give the filling substance, while the bread keeps the texture softer around the edges. White or malted bread is listed, so check which option your pub can serve. The generous layering makes the fish the centre of the sandwich rather than a minor filling.

Tartare sauce supplies the sharpness that balances the richness of the breaded coating. Its tang gives the sandwich a more savoury edge without changing its familiar, comforting character. This is a straightforward lunch choice for someone who wants crunchy fish in bread rather than a plated fish dish.
